parameters.name: ClientToken
parameters.description: A client-generated token to ensure the idempotence of the request. The token must be unique across requests and is case-sensitive. It can contain up to 64 ASCII characters.

parameters.name: DbPassword
parameters.description: The password used to access the database.

parameters.name: DbUserName
parameters.description: The username used to access the database.

parameters.name: GatewayId
parameters.description: The ID of the database gateway.

parameters.name: Host
parameters.description: The hostname or IP address of the database.

parameters.name: Port
parameters.description: The port number of the database.
